name: loewe-verification-v1
frozen: 2026-11-06 08:34 PST (commit fa7e528), before any number below was computed.
admissibility: A Loewe expectation y for doses (x_a, x_b) is admissible under the scorer's definition (calculate_synergy_score.R, Loewe equation with LL.4/L.4 fits) if the scorer's equation residual at y is below 1e-6 and y lies strictly inside both fitted effect ranges, where the equation is real-valued.
independent_implementation: Forward curves only: theta = x_a / D_a(y) in (0, 1) solves f_a(x_a / theta) = f_b(x_b / (1 - theta)); bisection on logit(theta) in [-60, 60], 200 steps. Defined for co-increasing and co-decreasing curves; opposite or flat curves have no Loewe expectation.
classes: Native fallbacks (nleqslv code >= 3 or error): 'artifact' if an admissible root exists, split into 'solver at root' (native solution within 0.05 inhibition points of it) and 'solver failed'; 'definition' if no root exists or curves run in opposite directions. Accepted native solutions are checked against the same root.
score_effects: Block and pair-cell Loewe scores with admissible roots (capped at 100, as the scorer caps references) in place of the native reference, for three sets: solver-at-root only; all admissible roots on co-increasing curves (the response_analysis audit set); all admissible roots. Context: the same native solver with the HSA fallback instead of the summed-dose fallback.
model_effects: evaluation: the existing out-of-fold identity panel network (phase2_panel_neural) scored against published and corrected labels
training: the same network and script (experiments/phase2/panel_neural.py on the pipeline branch, seed 2026) retrained on each label version and scored against its own label
